Sec. 17-3 (self-contained retirement community resolutions, road lists not found online), Marion Co. Ord. 03-26 (all streets in Villages of Marion County), Lady Lake Sec. 17-3 (golf cart communities, streets designated by signage), Fruitland Park (streets ≤30 mph + map PDF), Wildwood O2026-28 (ArcGIS map, imported). Banned-road list comes from a 2018 Villages-News compilation of county/city rules + thevillagesflorida.com; may be dated (Wildwood replaced its rules in July 2026).
Night driving with lights (F.S. 316.212(6)) not modelled; LSVs allowed on multi-modal paths per Max.
Pine Ridge Dairy Rd crossing of CR 468 not found as an OSM intersection; not added.
Wildwood map PRIVATE roads keep the default assumption; Wildwood streets not on the city map keep the default assumption.
Crossings are modelled as a 40 m allowed stretch of the major road around the signal.

OSM golf_cart=yes roads tagged 35 mph (parts of Hillsborough Trail, Stillwater Trail, Odell Circle, Paige Pl, Pinellas Pl) are now BLOCKED for golf carts per VCDD 'prohibited from roadways posted 35 mph or more'; if any are actually posted 30, add an override.
Sumter County self-contained-retirement-community resolution road lists for The Villages are not published online; local streets <=30 assumed designated.
